I bought it myself and played through, and then replayed it again to get everything. Not only was it good enough to take seriously, it's one of my favorites in the series because it provides a much needed break and a bit of fun. A lot of loose ends were wrapped up, gave more in depth lore about Zanarkand and the characters, and if you complete it 100% gave a happy ending that I'd like to say was too syrupy sweet, but I was still honestly really happy to see.

If you are one of the ones like me who judged it unfairly, give it a try. If you like X, there is no reason to dislike X-2 because everything is still there, it just doesn't take itself too seriously and is more light hearted.
